_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_homes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', "monthly_budget" REAL NULL, "anniversary_date" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_list_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "completed_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_subscriptions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', "billing_cycle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', "next_billing_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "paid_by" TEXT NULL, "financed_through" TEXT NULL, "total_installments" INTEGER NULL, "paid_installments" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD', "paid_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "split_ratio" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5, "expense_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "payment_method" TEXT NULL, "is_transfer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_transfer" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_habits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cadence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily', "target_days_per_week" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_habit_checkins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "habit_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "checkin_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_calendar_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_all_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_all_day" IN (0, 1)), "location" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NULL, "owner" TEXT NULL DEFAULT 'both', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_outbox_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "encrypted_payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'savedLocally', "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_activity_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'savedLocally', "is_private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_private" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_notification_preferences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default', "mute_subscriptions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("mute_subscriptions" IN (0, 1)), "mute_lists" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("mute_lists" IN (0, 1)), "mute_expenses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("mute_expenses" IN (0, 1)), "mute_habits" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("mute_habits" IN (0, 1)), "mute_calendar" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("mute_calendar" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_roadmap_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "days_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_routine_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NULL DEFAULT 'both', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_applied_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_deleted_tombstones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_checkin_reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hour" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_pets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_pet_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "home_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pet_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
